data.name: Retort Biofuels
data.description: Retort Biofuels is a small company in Jaipur, Rajasthan, that sells through IndiaMart. Its listings include wood vinegar made by pyrolysing wood waste, biochar for agriculture, and babool wood chips sold as fuel. There is no sign of carbon-removal credit issuance, registry listings or a carbon-removal positioning; it works as a biomass-fuel and farm-input supplier.
